Want more natural voices?

On iPhone or iPad: Settings → Accessibility → Read & Speak → Voices → English. Choose a different voice or download a higher-quality version where offered, then reopen the reader and press Refresh voices.

On a Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Read & Speak (or Spoken Content) → System voice. Add voices there, then refresh this page.

The browser decides which installed voices it exposes. The choices above are real available voices, not pitch changes to the same voice.

CHATGPT CONNECTION

Checking direct connection support…

Connect this chat

Open this reader in the latest ChatGPT desktop app’s built-in browser, alongside your conversation. Use GPT-5.6 Sol or Terra. In the address bar, select Site tools and check that the two JUICE Reader tools are listed.

Tell ChatGPT: “Use JUICE Reader. Send each completed reply over two paragraphs to the reader before posting the same reply here. Start by checking the connection.”

Keep the reader open. ChatGPT sends replies through its tools; this page cannot watch your conversations by itself. Site tools are currently available on supported desktop accounts, not in the iPhone or iPad app. In Safari, you can still paste and listen.

Voice or sound trouble?

Choose another voice, check your volume, and press Read aloud again. If a chat app's browser is silent, open this page in Safari. Resume may repeat a few words on devices without word tracking.

Available voices vary by device. A voice labelled “online” may send text to its voice provider. For sensitive text, choose a voice labelled “on-device”.
